hypothesis: Physical text-paint envelopes include ink outside logical glyph boxes; uniform transformed outward rasterization plus a residual guard conserves the full source image without page-specific fixes.
frozen_inputs: Eight original fixtures, each at scale1.25 and4; existing GroupNorm page3 is mechanism regression only. Original fixtures cover italic bearings, radical, transformed text, stroke text, clipped Form, CropBox offsets, rotation, colored transparency and annotation.
uniform_rule: All fill/stroke text/path/image/shade bounds transformed through page rotation and scale, subtract actual pixmap origin, floor/ceil outward plus one pixel raster support. Any unexplained ink keeps entire original page. Logical boxes never substitute for painted extents.
metrics: Exact source RGB reconstruction and residual pixel count before fallback; not semantics, object ownership or reflow success.
stop: One frozen pass; any uncovered ordinary paint is a negative result; annotations may intentionally require whole-page fallback. No output-informed epsilon changes.
